items.name: Rectified Spirit
items.description: A clear, high-proof spirit produced by fermenting a clean source of sugars or starches, then repeatedly distilling the wash until most flavor and impurities have been removed.
items.alchemicalUse: The standard alcoholic solvent for tinctures, draughts, botanical extracts, and other preparations whose active principles must be drawn into a stable liquid medium.

items.name: Alcohest
items.description: An unnaturally clear alchemical solvent prepared by further rectifying strong spirit over mineral salts and fixing the final distillate with a small quantity of precious metal.
items.alchemicalUse: A high-grade solvent capable of suspending magical, mineral, and botanical essences that ordinary alcohol cannot reliably hold.

items.name: Distilled Water
items.description: Water purified by boiling and condensation until salts, sediment, and most ordinary impurities have been left behind.
items.alchemicalUse: A neutral aqueous medium used when mineral content or contamination might spoil a delicate formulation.

items.name: Sharp Vinegar
items.description: A strongly acidic vinegar deliberately cultured and aged for workshop use rather than the table.
items.alchemicalUse: Used to extract, preserve, dissolve, or temper substances that do not respond well to alcohol or oil.

items.name: Pressed Oil
items.description: A clean, mild fixed oil pressed from suitable fruits, nuts, or seeds and strained for workshop use.
items.alchemicalUse: The standard carrier for salves, infused oils, weapon coatings, and preparations meant to remain on a surface rather than be swallowed.

items.name: Honey Syrup
items.description: A clarified syrup of honey and purified water, reduced to a smooth, stable consistency.
items.alchemicalUse: Suspends powders, softens bitter preparations, and provides a viscous ingestible carrier for restorative and medicinal draughts.

items.name: Resinous Binder
items.description: A tacky alchemical medium made from purified plant resins and a volatile solvent, formulated to remain workable until exposed to air.
items.alchemicalUse: Helps powders, pigments, irritants, and magical reagents adhere to weapons, ammunition, surfaces, or one another.

items.name: Medicinal Charcoal
items.description: Finely prepared charcoal selected for purity, ground and washed until suitable for medicinal and alchemical work.
items.alchemicalUse: Used as an absorbent, purifier, filtering material, and stabilizing dry ingredient in treatments involving toxins or spoiled mixtures.

items.name: Unguent Base
items.description: A smooth, neutral ointment base prepared from refined oil and a thickening agent, made to hold active ingredients against the skin.
items.alchemicalUse: The standard foundation for salves, balms, protective ointments, and other thick topical preparations.
